articleTitle: Impact of Degradation Mechanisms in Gate Stress Tests on the Hard-Switching Behavior of 1.2 kV SiC Power MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: Long term stability of gate oxides is a crucial aspect for the reliability of SiC MOSFETs. In this paper the impact of gate bias driven degradation mechanisms on electrical parameters have been investigated for SiC MOSFETs with planar and trench MOS structure. Therefore, high temperature gate bias tests have been carried out. The periodically increased gate voltage until the time dependent dielectric breakdown led to an increase of the threshold voltage and to a change of the internal capacitances. To capture the behavior of the threshold voltage precisely, the hysteresis method has been applied during intermediate read-outs. Additionally, the switching behavior of the specimens has been measured in double pulse tests to analyze the impact of the shifted electrical parameters on switching losses and waveforms.

articleTitle: Ultra-high Voltage BCD Technology Integrated 1000 V 3-D Split-Superjunction devices
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: A 0.25 µm ultra-high voltage Bipolar CMOS DMOS (BCD) process platform is reported in this work, which integrates the 1000 V 3-D Split-Superjunction lateral double-diffused metal–oxide semiconductor (split-SJ LDMOS) with ultra-low specific on-resistance R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on,sp</inf>. The split-SJ LDMOS features split N- and P-pillars in the drift region to optimize the electric field near the drain and continuous pillars in the termination region for the continuous depletion. The highly doped SJ region also acts as a low resistance current path in the on-state to realize a lower R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on,sp</inf>. By optimizing the split-SJ layout, doping dose and field plates, the split-SJ LDMOS was fabricated with an ultra-high voltage V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</inf> of 1002 V. A tested R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on,sp</inf> of 12.1 Ω•mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was observed in the split-SJ LDMOS, which is 36.73% lower than the theoretical limit of the triple RESURF technology under the same V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</inf>. This SJ-based ultrahigh voltage BCD technology also provides other variable integrated devices, including 1000 V nJFET, asymmetrical 120 V / 150 V LDMOS, 7.5 V to 80 V CMOS, 20 V NPN and PNP, and poly resistor.

articleTitle: Suppression of current collapse by Access-region Carrier Enhancement technique in GaN-MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: Current collapse phenomenon, which is increase of on-resistance caused by high drain voltage at off-state, is a problem to be solved in reliabilities of GaN-based devices. In order to reduce the current collapse, it is necessary to identify traps generated when the drain voltage is applied and reduce the traps. In this paper, we investigate the traps which cause the current collapse by measuring device-capacitance characteristics, and demonstrate that the current collapse is suppressed by a proposed device structure using Access-region Carrier Enhancement (ACE) technique in the Normally-off GaN-MOSFETs. These results show that the proposed GaN-MOSFETs with ACE structure are promising for practical power semiconductor devices.

articleTitle: Superior Eoff –Vcesat Trade-off of 5V-Gate-Driven 3.3kV Back-gate-Controlled IGBTs (BC-IGBTs)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: Superior performance of Back-gate-Controlled IGBT (BC-IGBT) by optimizing both front side and back side design has been demonstrated. Front side trench gate extrusion D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</inf>-D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">P</inf> (trench depth minus p-base depth) and back side p-collector dose N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">PC</inf> were varied to see their effects on the performance. Combining the increase of N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">PC</inf> and D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</inf>-D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">P</inf> with back gate control, significant reduction of V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cesat</inf> (2.1 to 1.7V) was realized, while keeping E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</inf> unchanged. These results show that BC-IGBT is an attractive candidate for a high performance switching device.

articleTitle: Optimisation of the carrier lifetime profile in 1.2kV planar and trench SiC MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive study on the optimisation of the lifetime profile in the drift region of 1.2kV planar and trench 4H-SiC MOSFETs. The performance of the body diodes is examined for the first time for a range of single step lifetime profiles in the epi region by means of a dedicated TCAD model, thereby enabling the identification of a trade-off between the voltage drop, the reverse recovery, and the risk of forward bias degradation. Based on this, a set of buffer designs is investigated as a means of containing bipolar degradation and hence loosening this trade-off.

articleTitle: Three-level Gate Drive Technique for Enhancing Switching Loss Reduction in Triple-Gate IGBTs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: A three-level gate drive control technique concept has been proposed to drastically improve both turn-on loss (Eon) and turn-off loss (Eoff) for a 1.2-kV triple-gate insulated-gate bipolar transistor (TG-IGBT). Eon and Eoff were reduced to 66% and 35% respectively compared with a conventional single-gate IGBT. This result indicates that it is possible to overcome the limitations of Si by optimizing the device structure and gate drive control.

articleTitle: Experimentally Demonstrating Fast Neutron Irradiation Effect on High-di/dt Switching Characteristics of Insulated Gate Triggered Thyristor for Pulse Power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: In this work, the fast neutron irradiation effects on high-di/dt switching characteristics of IGTT is demonstrated and investigated by experiments and TCAD simulations. Experimental measurements show that the breakdown voltage of IGTT slightly increases, but the leakage current exhibits tens time incensement after neutron flux of 3.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>n/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. As for the pulse switching performances, more than 40% decline range of peak current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">peak</inf>) and di/dt are detected at low operating voltage of 400V. However, at relatively high operating voltage of 1400V, the decline range of I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">peak</inf> and di/dt are only ~15%, indicating the fast neutron irradiation has different effect on high-di/dt switching characteristics when the operating voltage changes. Moreover, there is about 300kW power loss of irradiated IGTT increases after neutron flux of 1.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup>n/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, causing significant temperature rise (ΔT).

articleTitle: Interaction Mechanism Between CGD and CDS Based on Space Competition and Optimization Method of Dynamic Characteristic for 600V Super-Junction VDMOS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: A novel view of the interaction between C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GD</inf> and C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</inf> based on space competition is proposed in this paper. For small cell pitch super-junction vertical double-diffused MOSFET (SJ VDMOS), C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GD</inf> and C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</inf> have a close interaction in the center part of the depletion region. By changing the source-end structure, the electric field lines originally contributed to the C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GD</inf> can be collected by the source end, thereby realizing the indirect modulation of the C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GD</inf>. C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GD</inf> and C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</inf> present an opposite trend as one falling and the other rising. By this theory, we propose a SJ VDMOS with additional P-type implantation (API) based on a multi-epitaxy/multi-implant platform. Both simulated and experimental results validate the feasibility of reducing C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GD</inf> with the easy-modified C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</inf>. SJ VDMOS with API realizes a faster switching process, and the overshoot remains low while achieving BV > 600 V and a low R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON,SP</inf> of 11.35 mΩ∙cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: A Pathway to Improve the Reliability of p-GaN Gate HEMTs through Buffer Hole Accumulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: In this report, we investigate the trap-related mechanisms of the dynamic on-resistance (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON,dyn</inf>) increase and short circuit capability of p-GaN Gate HEMTs and suggest a pathway to improve the reliability characteristics. The trapping phenomena that occur in the buffer during the device operation are analyzed by measuring the spatio-temporal potential in the drift region between the gate and drain. The wafer level transient voltage measurements confirm that both dynamic on-resistance degradation and short circuit deterioration can be improved by adjusting the hole traps in the buffer structure. Our new generation device with an optimized buffer structure shows less than 10 % of R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON,dyn</inf> increase even at 150 ℃ and 1000 s of offstress condition as well as the short circuit ruggedness.

articleTitle: Integrated Time and Space Carrier Controllable HiGT (i-TASC) with Widely Designable Backside Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: An integrated dual-gate time and space carrier controllable high-conductivity IGBT (i-TASC) that consists of a high-conductivity HC region and a high-speed HS region fabricated within one chip is proposed. Due to the stored carrier control by the dual-gate and local lifetime at backside, a –45% turn-off loss compared with the leading-edge 6.5-kV IGBTs was demonstrated. The proposed i-TASC has a widely designable backside p-collector layer, that can optimize the collector-emitter saturation voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CEsat</inf>) and maximum inverter output current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf>) in accordance with switching frequency (f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</inf>) without changing the chip size.

articleTitle: Lifetime Control Free Cathode Side Concept for Si-Based Power Diode Targeting High-Speed Operation and High Dynamic Ruggedness
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: We present the first advanced power diode technology that matches the diameter of a large Si wafer (≥200mm). Our proposed diode consists of a new cathode with a thin wafer process-induced crystal defect layer and a double-implanted layer in combination with a relaxed field of cathode technology. The new diode demonstrates high-speed operation, a low cross-point current, a low junction leakage current, and improved dynamic robustness without a lifetime control technique. The thermal stability of the proposed cathode concept is equal to that of a defect free power diode. The proposed cathode concept further evolves the RFC diode technology.

articleTitle: A generalized sub-circuit model to enable accurate CHC aging simulation and spatial defect profiling in LDMOS
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: This work demonstrates a novel sub-circuit based model to capture the unique bias dependence of Channel-Hot-Carrier (CHC) induced on-resistance (RDSon) degradation in Laterally Diffused MOSFET (LDMOS). The proposed methodology also provides a simple and fast metrology to identify spatial location of CHC induced defect generation in LDMOS. SPICE simulations of a half bridge converter circuit using the new proposed model show significant differences in key performance metrics compared to a conventional model demonstrating the importance of the proposed model for aging simulations.

articleTitle: Novel Hybrid SiGe-Silicon 5V pLDMOS on 28nm HKMG technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: Power Management IC (PMIC) of mobile devices typically requires the adoption of low-cost 5V LDMOS devices [1]. Due to the intrinsically higher electron mobility, the recent work has been focused on improving the 5V nLDMOS device by reducing the Rdson, which is critical for power efficiency [2],[3]. However, provided that a good Rdson is achieved for pLDMOS devices, it can replace nLDMOS as a High-side device for the DC-DC converter without requiring complex bootstrap gate control circuitry [4]. In this paper, we demonstrate a best-in-class 5V pLDMOS device with Rdson=2mΩ*mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and Breakdown Voltage (BV)>10V in 28nm gate-first High-K Metal Gate (HKMG) technology without any additional process step or mask on top of the baseline process.

articleTitle: Investigation of Stability and Oscillations at Power Modules with Low Stray Inductance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: This paper presents an overview of different oscillation types, including ways of simulation and experimental verification. Understanding and distinguishing the different oscillation types is the key for optimization of the new low-inductive, high power module platform that uses Semikron’s Direct Pressed Die (DPD) technology

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Potential of nLDMOSFETs with Partial Drain Slit Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: It is well-known that a drain multi-finger STI nLDMOSFET structure in which an STI section and a silicon surface section in the drift region are repeated in the channel width direction can improve the specific on-resistance (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sp</inf>) versus the off-state breakdown voltage (BV<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</inf>) trade-off. However, an nLDMOSFET to which this structure is applied is not suitable for high BV<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">off</inf> (> 50 V) because it is difficult to relax the electric field at both sides of the drain silicon slit and at the channel side edge of the silicon slit. To overcome the first drawback, it is proposed to incorporate an STI section without silicon slits into the drain side region (partial drain slit structure) in this paper. The gate polysilicon cutout structure on an accumulation region is also proposed to overcome the second drawback.

articleTitle: Measurement of the PtH defect depth profiles in fully processed silicon high-voltage diodes by improved current transient spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: A new, simplified, and more versatile current transient spectroscopy (CTS) measurement setup is demonstrated. With this setup, the depth profile of the platinum-hydrogen (PtH) defect in fully processed silicon high-voltage (HV) test diodes is investigated. It is shown that a proton field stop (FS) at the backside of these test devices suppresses the in-diffusion of hydrogen (H) leading to a significant reduction of the PtH defect concentration throughout the entire volume of the diode. Furthermore, a strong correlation of the depth profile of the PtH defect and the leakage current is observed. Thus, we conclude that the PtH defect is the main generation center in the investigated devices.

articleTitle: High Density Bidirectional Lithium Ion Battery Disconnect Switch With Ultralow Specific On-Resistance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: A battery disconnect switch (BDS) with high cell density is researched in this paper. Compared with the conventional structure, the proposed BDS reduces the cell pitch by leading P+ region from the X direction to Z direction, further improving the cell density and decreasing the total BDS resistance simultaneously. Based on this, we have designed a BDS that, usually applied in battery management system (BMS), can realize bidirectional conduction and blocking. Furthermore, a 22-V trench power MOSFET in BDS is analytically designed and experimentally implemented, which obtains the ultralow specific on-resistance (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on,sp</inf>) of 3.68 mΩ•mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gs</inf> = 4.5 V.

articleTitle: Investigations on Unclamped-Inductive-Switching Behaviors of p-GaN HEMTs at Cryogenic Temperature
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: In this paper, the unclamped-inductive switching (UIS) behaviors of GaN-based high electron mobility transistors with p-GaN cap (p-GaN HEMTs) at cryogenic temperature (CT) are investigated in details. Unlike the temperature-dependent avalanche process induced failure for Si-based MOSFETs, the withstanding behaviors of p-GaN HEMTs are not affected by temperature. With the help of TCAD simulations and experimental characterizations, the temperature-independent inverse piezoelectric effect induced by high electric field during UIS process is considered as the original failure inducement. Meanwhile, it is demonstrated that p-GaN HEMTs have higher robustness at extremely low temperature scene under repetitive UIS stress. After enduring 5M UIS stress cycles at CT, the threshold voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</inf>) only increases by 0.06 V and ON-state resistance (R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dson</inf>) increases by 4 mΩ, implying higher device reliability at CT. In conclusion, compared with traditional Si-based devices, p-GaN HEMTs are more competitive in extremely low temperature scene.

articleTitle: High-Voltage Fully Integrated Gate Driver IC with Galvanic Isolation based on Embedded Coreless Transformers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: The paper presents a single-channel gate driver IC with galvanic isolation that uses embedded coreless transformer technology. The IC is suitable for driving and monitoring Si-IGBTs or SiC-MOSFETs up to 1700 V and gate currents of ±3 Apeak directly. For higher gate currents, external post-amplifiers can be used. A 0.35 µm mixed-signal CMOS technology was extended by using a very thick isolation layer process to form high-voltage coreless transformers or capacitors between different metallization layers to get an impulse withstand voltage capability of > 10 kV.

articleTitle: A High-voltage Silicon-On-Insulator Lateral IGBT with Segmented Trenches for Improved Short circuit Ruggedness
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: A novel LIGBT with segmented trenches (STs) is proposed for improved short circuit ruggedness in this paper. STs are inserted in the drift region of the novel structure. STs can be formed simultaneously with isolation trenches by one-step etching and subsequently polysilicon refilling. The polysilicon in STs is connected to the emitter by metal interconnection. The electric potential modulation and hole blocking effect concepts are proposed in this work. In the saturation area, the electronic potential at the end of N-type inversion channel can be lowered by grounded STs, resulting in weakened electron injection. In the liner area, the holes from collector are blocked by STs, and thus the conductivity modulation is enhanced. As a result, the novel structure obtains an ultra-low I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sat</inf> without increasing V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">on</inf> and 406% increase in t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sc</inf>.

articleTitle: Introduction of Highly Reliable Versatile Analog Platform with Embedded NVM for Automotive Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: This paper demonstrates a highly reliable versatile analog platform with embedded NVM for automotive applications. The platform provides LDMOS up to 60V, 1.5-5V CMOS, bipolar devices, diodes, and other passive devices. Especially, three kinds of LDMOS structures (STI-based, stepped oxide-based, and LOCOS-based) can be selected from the viewpoint of performance, reliability, rated voltage, and cost. Although the stepped oxide-based and the LOCOS-based LDMOS have lower on-resistance and better reliability characteristics than the STI-based one, additional process steps are needed. Moreover, highly reliable embedded NVM (Floadia LEE flash G1) with considering the effect of the negative carrier injection from switching LDMOS was integrated. The Vth distribution of 64 KB array showed no change even after 100k P/E cycles under 150°C condition. In the retention test, which applied 250°C/3hours baking after 100k P/E cycles, no Vth distribution change was observed and AEC-Q100/Grade-0 was achieved.

articleTitle: Investigation of Dynamic-QGD on Enhancement-Mode AlGaN/GaN MIS-HEMTs with SiNx Passivation Dielectric
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: Effect of bulk states in passivation dielectrics on dynamic gate-drain capacitance (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GD</inf>) and Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GD</inf> of GaN-based power devices, was systematically investigated by inductive-load switching, voltage/temperature-dependent capacitance-voltage (C-V) and deep level transient spectroscopy (DLTS) measurements. DLTS measurements confirm that the bulk states with activation energy (E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</inf>-E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</inf>) higher than 1.1 ± 0.05 eV, presents in SiN<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> passivation dielectric grown by low-pressure chemical vapor deposition (LPCVD). It is revealed that the trapping/de-trapping of these bulk states will give rise to Q<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GD</inf> instability in T-shape gate enhancement-mode (E-mode) AlGaN/GaN MIS-HEMTs (metal-insulator-semiconductor high-electron-mobility transistors), leading to undesirable degradation of switching characteristics.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of 6.5 kV 4H-SiC Discrete Packaged MOSFET, JBSFET, and Co-Pack (MOSFET and JBS Diode)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: This paper reports the detailed comparison of packaged level, 6.5 kV rated 4H-SiC power MOSFET, MOSFET co-packaged with JBS diode (Co-Pack), and monolithically integrated 6.5 kV 4H-SiC MOSFET and JBS diode (JBSFET). JBSFET was designed to disable the PN turn for reliability purposes and save the chip and process cost from the one-chip integration and single metal scheme. Static and dynamic electrical characteristics of stand-alone MOSFET, Co-Pack, and JBSFET are compared to signify the benefit of JBSFET in terms of performance, reliability, and economical point of view.

articleTitle: Terminal Breakdown Voltage Degradation by Avalanche Stress Induced Hot-Hole Injection in Split Gate Trench Power MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: A terminal breakdown voltage (BV) degradation of split gate trench power MOSFET (SGT-MOSFET) is studied in this work. High electric field and impact ionization generation rate (IIG) will increase the hot-hole injection at the interface of Si/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> under avalanche stress, which leads to the destruction of charge balance and is characterized as BV degradation. The typical ΔBV failure rate (P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">F</inf>) is more than 36.5% on a wafer, which is random and unacceptable. Based on this, the most probable position is located and key parameters are discussed by simulations of a typical terminal. Furthermore, an SGT-MOSFET with optimized trench end mesa (m<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>) and trench depth (d<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">tr</inf>) is experimentally implemented, which possesses a wider design margin and robust BV. The experiment realizes a P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">F</inf> reduced to 0.5%.

articleTitle: Speed-Up Gate Pulse Method to Suppress Switching Loss and Surge Voltage for MOS Gate Power Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: There is a trade-off between surge voltage and switching loss in power semiconductors, and it has been difficult to reduce both. In order to solve this problem, the digital gate drive method has been studied. However, the digital gate drive method has the problem that the gate drive circuit is complicated and it takes time to search for the optimal drive waveform. In this study, we have proposed a new method that does not require optimization search, but only adds a simple circuit, which is expected to have the same effect as the digital gate drive method.

articleTitle: 300 mA/mm Drain Current Density P-Type Enhancement-Mode Oxidized Si-terminated (111) Diamond MOSFETs with ALD Al2O3 Gate Insulator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: In this study, high-performance normally–off oxidized Si-terminated (C–Si) diamond metal–oxide– semiconductor field–effect transistors (MOSFETs) have been achieved using (111) diamond and Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> gate insulator with maximum drain current density (ID_MAX) up to 300 mA/mm, which is a record value among Enhancement-mode single crystalline diamond devices to date. During selective growth of heavily-boron-doped (p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">++</sup>)-diamond MOSFETs utilizing a SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> mask, carbon–silicon bonding was established at SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/diamond interface. C–Si diamond MOSFET will be a promising candidate for fulfilling the requirements of high output capability and safety operation in some power device applications.

articleTitle: Demonstration of BaTiO3 Integrated kV-class AlGaN/GaN Schottky Barrier Diodes with Record Average Breakdown Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: We introduce a high permittivity dielectric (BaTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>) integrated field-plate overlap design on hybrid AlGaN/GaN lateral Schottky barrier diodes for efficient field management to achieve superior breakdown performance at low turn-on voltages. Record average breakdown fields of 2.41 MV/cm were achieved for devices with an anode-to-cathode spacing of 4 μm while maintaining a low turn-on voltage of 0.6 V. The high breakdown fields enabled a high-power figure of merit > 2 GW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in devices with an anode-to-cathode separation of 8 μm. The reported results demonstrate the potential of integrating high-permittivity dielectrics with GaN lateral SBDs for realizing highly efficient kV class rectifiers.

articleTitle: Reverse recovery noise reduction using multi-trench-gate super-junction power MOSFETs with floating columns
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 34th International Symposium on Power Semiconductor Devices and ICs (ISPSD)
abstract: Multi (two)-trench-gate (2-TG) super-junction MOSFETs (SJ MOS) with the p-column separated from the p-base are proposed for application in automobiles at 60V and below. In this report, we further clarify the mechanism behind recovery noise reduction in the 2-TG SJ MOS. We thereby successfully achieve compatibility between soft recovery and performance (BV<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DSS</inf> vs R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SP</inf>) in scaled low-voltage SJ MOSFETs.
